entities.summary: Archibald Clark Kerr, 1st Baron Inverchapel,, known as Sir Archibald Clark Kerr between 1935 and 1946, was a British diplomat. He served as Ambassador to the Soviet Union between 1942 and 1946 and to the United States between 1946 and 1948.
